snippet.text: step at line 287-289: heq : d.h * (finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2 * (1 / (3 * d.h / 2))) = (2 / 3) * finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2, then `rw [heq] at h`, giving h : d.h * (∫ t in Ioi y, Real.exp (t - y) * finalAngular d (t, eta) ^ 2) ≤ (2 / 3) * finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2. The theorem's own statement (line 277) is the weaker `≤ finalAngular d (y, eta) ^ 2`.
